rule: shared land border, or at most 100 km apart over the sea by a connection that crosses no third country; added by hand: AI-SX, GR-IT

manual_pairs.AI-SX: neighbouring islands over the sea; every straight connection from Anguilla to Sint Maarten crosses French Saint-Martin (MF), which lies between them on the same island
manual_pairs.GR-IT: Natural Earth 1:10m lacks the Diapontia islands (Othonoi, Mathraki, Ereikoussa), about 80 km from Italy; measured from Corfu instead: just over 100 km

source.data: Natural Earth admin-0 map units 1:10m v5.1.2 (public domain)

unit_codes: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; units without one: the code of GBIF's reverse geocoder (2026-10-27)
